Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24089/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24089/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009065954/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24089/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]] list on DeckTech (''Saber combat my way'') and a [[Light]] [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]] list (''Rebel Strike Team- Stay the hell of endor'').<ref name="dt-23490">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23490 Rebel Strike Team- Stay the hell of endor], DeckTech (Mike "Quione" Noneofyourbusiness, 22 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23490/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23490/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009153012/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23490/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
